brch 0.1.0

  • First version. format_db07(), db_label(), inspect_db(), convert_db07_to_db25() and convert_db25_to_db07() moved here unchanged from daos, with the bundled Statistics Denmark keys and labels, the script that rebuilds them, and their tests. daos no longer has them and does not forward to brch.
